title: Neko scan overview
description: A narrow centred column on a white-to-lemon wash: a tracked eyebrow, a big soft-serif title and a short intro, then a stack of white rounded rows (square thumbnail, capitalised label, slate caption), then a white card with a wide photo, a smaller serif heading and a square-bulleted list, and a charcoal button below.
notes: the wash fades from background into highlight; the next section (neko-focus-tabs) continues on highlight
every thumbnail and the card photo are media slots
